import { dbOf } from "./module-db.ts";
import { columns, published, category, combined, field, sideEffect, effectCondition, mutating, raw, relation,
  relationBranch, nestedRelation, recursive, partial, takeFragment, identifier, column, alias, opaque,
  commaProjection, functionName, suffix, tableChoice, calledTag, rebound } from "./helpers.ts";
const sql = dbOf("publication");
export function good(now: Date, q: {category: string | null; tags: string[] | null}, flag: boolean) {
  return sql`SELECT ${columns}, ${field(flag)} AS shown FROM publications p WHERE ${published(now)} ${combined(q)}`;
}
export function inline(flag: boolean) {
  return sql`SELECT ${flag ? sql`p.id` : sql`p.title`} FROM publications p`;
}
export function nativeDate(q: {now?: Date; category: string | null}) {
  const now = q.now ?? new Date();
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${published(now)} ${q.category ? sql`AND p.at >= ${new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400_000)}` : sql``}`;
}
export function fakeDate(Date: new () => Date) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${published(new Date())}`; }
export function fakeTime(now: {getTime(): number}) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${published(new Date(now.getTime()))}`;
}
export function sideEffectUse(now: Date) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${sideEffect(now)}`; }
export function effectConditionUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${effectCondition()}`; }
export function mutatingUse(n: number) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${mutating(n)}`; }
export function rawUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${raw()}`; }
export function relationUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${relation()}`; }
export function relationBranchUse(flag: boolean) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${relationBranch(flag)}`; }
export function nestedRelationUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${nestedRelation()}`; }
export function recursiveUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${recursive()}`; }
export function partialUse(flag: boolean) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${partial(flag)}`; }
export function argumentUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${takeFragment(sql`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)`)}`; }
export function identifierUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM ${identifier()}`; }
export function expressionAsRelation() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM ${column()}`; }
export function commaRelation() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications ${commaProjection()}`; }
export function composedFunction() { return sql`SELECT ${functionName()}()`; }
export function composedIdentifier() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publi${suffix()}`; }
export function differentRelations(flag: boolean) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM ${tableChoice(flag)}`; }
export function calledTagUse() { return sql`SELECT ${calledTag()} FROM publications`; }
export function reboundUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${rebound()}`; }
export function capped(flag: boolean) {
  return sql`SELECT ${field(flag)}, ${field(flag)}, ${field(flag)}, ${field(flag)},
    ${field(flag)}, ${field(flag)}, ${field(flag)}, ${field(flag)} FROM publications`;
}
export function aliasUse(now: Date) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${alias(now)}`; }
export function opaqueUse() { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${opaque()}`; }
export function mixed(now: Date) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${published(now)} AND ${opaque()}`; }
